meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 Codex 替代或配合 Claude 作为智能体规划器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Claude 之外使用 Codex 作为智能体核心规划器
copy.tagline_en: Use Codex as a full agent provider alongside or instead of Claude
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use Codex as the primary agent planner instead of or alongside Claude

howto.what: 安装后,系统新增了 Codex 作为可选的代理后端。你可以把某个群组切换成由 Codex 驱动(支持规划、工具调用、MCP 工具、服务端历史与断点续聊),Claude 可继续用于其他群组。
howto.when: 当你在宿主机上运行 `ncl groups config update --id <群组ID> --provider codex` 切换某组,或把实例默认代理设为 codex 时,Codex 接管该组的代理运行。

say.text: 请安装 add-codex,把 Codex 加为代理提供者。
say.note: 将执行文件复制、barrel 接入和构建。

say.text: 把群组 abc 的 provider 换成 codex。
say.note: 该组将重启并以 Codex 运行。

say.text: 把新群组的默认代理设为 Codex。
say.note: 会设置默认并重启宿主,只影响之后新建的组。

howto.what_en: After install, Codex becomes an optional agent backend. You can switch a group to run on Codex (planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume) while Claude stays available for others.
howto.when_en: When you run `ncl groups config update --id <group-id> --provider codex` for a group, or set the instance default agent provider to codex, Codex takes over that group's agent runtime.

say_en.text: Please install add-codex to add Codex as an agent provider.
say_en.note: Copies files, wires barrels, and builds.

say_en.text: Switch group abc's provider to codex.
say_en.note: The group restarts and runs on Codex.

say_en.text: Set the default agent provider to Codex for new groups.
say_en.note: Sets the default and restarts host; affects only new groups.
